data.content_ref: inline:The reduction claim is asserted rather than demonstrated. SRC_001 claims its registry-size account 'reduces to' SRC_004's order-effect explanation 'as a special case,' but provides no derivation or mechanism showing how mutation count determines whether guard installation order can produce a selective effect. It merely asserts that both variables matter without demonstrating that size is a special case of order rather than an interacting factor or independent cause.
